items.title: Hegseth attacks Europe over migration with beach 'invasion' D-Day speech
items.description: The US defence secretary was speaking in Normandy, 82 years after allied forces launched their operation to liberate Nazi-occupied north-western Europe.

items.title: Steve Rosenberg: Russia's economic forum overshadowed by drone attacks on St Petersburg
items.description: The BBC's Russia editor saw Putin's flagship economic event overshadowed by Ukrainian drones attacks.

items.title: Huge crowds throng Madrid streets for Pope's open-air mass
items.description: The pontiff waved at those gathered from his popemobile as he arrived at the Plaza de Cibeles.

items.title: Iran says staff blocked from entering US after players given World Cup visas
items.description: Iranian officials say technical staff have been denied visas, hours after the US said players could enter the country.

items.title: Insecurity and instability drive voters in Peru's tight presidential race
items.description: After eight presidents in 10 years, many voters are looking for stability so the next president can focus on tackling crime and inequality.

items.title: Funeral held for baby shot dead by Israeli troops in occupied West Bank
items.description: The seven-month-old boy's shrouded body was wrapped in a Palestinian flag and carried by his father to the graveyard.

items.title: Ragas and symphonies: Indian maestro Ilaiyaraaja is still reshaping music 50 years on
items.description: Fifty years after his debut, Ilaiyaraaja remains one of the most celebrated composers in Indian cinema.

items.title: 'It was either killed or be killed' - ongoing nightmares of an ex-child soldier in Somalia
items.description: Yusuf Ali, now 34, struggles with his memories living in Mogadishu surrounded by dark reminders of his past.

items.title: US and Iran exchange strikes in Gulf in latest test of ceasefire
items.description: The US military strikes Iranian drones and radar sites and Tehran says it has targeted US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

items.title: Lebanese general among three soldiers killed in Israeli attack on car
items.description: The Israeli military is investigating the incident in south Lebanon, where it is fighting Hezbollah.

items.title: Police officer turned Love Island US contestant faces hometown backlash
items.description: Sean Reifel's joined the cast of the popular reality series less than a year after he joined his hometown's police force.

items.title: Canada bans Texas cattle over flesh-eating screwworm outbreak in US
items.description: The ban came as a second infected calf was identified in Texas, and the US state declaring a state of disaster over the outbreak.
